english.title: Water undertaker disconnect service pipe or cut off water supply to premises when no power to do so
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a water undertaker,

(A)_[disconnected a service pipe]_
(B)_[cut off a supply of water]_

to premises at **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..) in a case in which you had no power to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to section 63(3)(a) and (4) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location,
being a water undertaker,
disconnected a service pipe to premises or otherwise cut off a supply of water to premises
in a case in which it has no power to do so under sections 60, 62 or 75 of the Water Industry Act 1991 or other enactment
